Review status: CONDITIONAL ACCEPT / REFRESH-SCAN REQUIRED.

The existing final security head fa3fe589759408172c647d932d8ce477d3ae20d4 has strong evidence: focused security 31/31, full Node 2678/2678, tracked/history scans with zero unresolved findings, boundary scan, production canary bundle scan, and hosted Quality + Security gates PASS.

The branch is now 23 develop commits behind. Current delta is primarily newly added architecture/task/audit documentation, but those files are inside the scanner's tracked/history scope; acceptance therefore requires one latest-develop integration and a full rescan on the combined tree.

Reuse this PR/branch only. Re-run tracked scan, history scan, client/server boundary, canary build/bundle, lint/typecheck/build and exact final-head hosted gates. Do not broaden allowlists merely to accommodate new documentation. Do not auto-merge.
